simulationId.description: ID of an existing simulation to run. When provided, scenarioId/personalityId/inline fields are ignored.

scenarioId.description: ID of an existing scenario. Cannot be combined with inline scenario.

scenario.description: Inline scenario configuration. Cannot be combined with scenarioId.

personalityId.description: ID of an existing personality. Cannot be combined with inline personality.

personality.description: Inline personality configuration. Cannot be combined with personalityId.

name.description: Optional name for this simulation entry
